title: 看板按文本字段或声明选项分道：空值记录全在第一页之后时，「未分类」道不显示（接 #37516）
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding from the #37516 card thread (PR #38112, os-dev-report 7232465642). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 · reach: a list-view kanban laned by a text field or by declared options, whose records with an empty or unmatched lane value all sit past page one · evidence: code read.
Dedupe: "kanban uncategorized lane past page text field", "declared options uncategorized windowed" → only #37516 (lookup lanes, the fix this follows).
Blocked-by: #38178

## 维护者速读

- 问题：看板按文本字段或按声明的选项分道时，如果空值或对不上任何道的记录都在第一页之后，「未分类」道就不画出来。用户看到的总数和各道加起来对不上，那些记录在看板上找不到。
- 修法：#37516（PR #38112）已经给查找字段分道修好了同一个问题，把同一条路放宽到文本字段和声明选项分道。
- 要你做的：无。

## Measured (code read)

- `bucketCardsIntoColumns` draws the Uncategorized lane only from the cards on the loaded page.
- PR #38112's gate in `ObjectKanban` (`keepUncolumned` / `extraLaneIds`) requires `laneTargetObject`, so it covers lookup lanes only. The claim on #37516 scoped text and option lanes out.

## Ask

1. A kanban laned by a text field or declared options keeps the Uncategorized lane when the empty-value count is known, even if no such card is on the loaded page. Use the same rule as #38112: counts are null on a partial or refused read.
2. Pins with ablations, as #38112's.

## Acceptance

- With empty-lane records only past page one, a text-field kanban and an option kanban both show Uncategorized with its count.
- Blocked-by: #37516 (same files; build on PR #38112).
